comparison.objective: Close a clamshell lockout around a valve lever and insert its steel lock bar.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated enclosure placement, hole alignment, and transverse bar insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Clamshell closed around the lever, bar resting through both holes, and robot released; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Lockout assembly tests enclosure and pin alignment, not an adjustable stop preserved against locknut torque.
